name: NVDebug Hardware Agent
description: HTTP bridge from OpenClaw to the NVIDIA Hardware Agent for NVDebug hardware fault triage.

baseUrl.description: Hardware Agent service base URL. Defaults to http://diagnostic-agent.

apiKey.description: Optional Hardware Agent API key. Defaults to DIAGNOSTIC_AGENT_API_KEY from the OpenClaw pod environment.

subagentEventsUrl.description: Optional Mosaic UI endpoint that receives live Hardware Agent subagent events.

enabledTools.description: Optional allowlist of Hardware Agent OpenClaw tool names to register.

disabledTools.description: Optional list of Hardware Agent OpenClaw tool names to suppress.

timeoutMs.label: Tool-call timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.help: NVDebug collections can take several minutes; 1800000 gives the full Hardware Agent path room to finish.

subagentEventsUrl.label: Subagent events URL
subagentEventsUrl.help: Mosaic UI endpoint for rendering nvdebug as a read-only subagent panel.
